text: The regex change replaces `\d+` with `\d` in the integer part of the number. Let me verify the behavioural impact in both checkouts.

Confirmed. The change to `parseRegExp` replaces `\d+` with `\d`, so the integer part of the number can only be a single digit. Inputs like `'10kb'` or `'100MB'` no longer match the regex and fall through to the `parseInt(val, 10)` fallback with unit `'b'`, silently returning the leading integer as bytes. Let me confirm the proof test fails on the mutant and passes on the pristine build.
